subject: Re: questions about the service
text: Thanks for your earlier message. To give you an accurate answer, I need a few details about the service you are considering. Please confirm whether you want basic assistance, a managed package, or one-off help with setup, along with your preferred start date and expected monthly volume. If the standard onboarding plan is too broad, I can suggest a lighter option focused on initial guidance, troubleshooting, and handover. That alternative is usually faster to arrange and better suited to a smaller budget, though it includes fewer follow-up reviews. If your project has fixed deliverables, mention the exact tasks, because that changes the estimate. Also note any tools or account roles you already have, since that avoids duplicate work and prevents scheduling delays. The sooner I have those points, the sooner I can confirm feasibility, send the breakdown, and answer whether the lighter option or a tailored package fits better. If timing is urgent, say so too, because limited availability may affect the quote right now.
